# Journeys

<!-- template: Copy to knowledge/product/journeys/README.md when the first journey is added. Run `adf.py route` to fill the routing table, then remove this comment. -->

User journeys, one file per journey: a goal a user completes from start to finish, such as signing up or paying an invoice. Name each file after the goal, such as `sign-up.md`.
